prompt: Why does the man suggest lighting both ends?
promptZh: 男方為什麼建議從兩端照光？

options.text: To see which end dries more quickly
options.whyZh: 燈是用來觀察陰影，不是測乾燥。

options.text: To check if the lamp needs replacing
To compare the colour with the door
options.whyZh: 對話沒提到以門的顏色為基準。

options.text: To see if a shadow shifts with the light
options.zh: 觀察陰影是否隨光線改變位置
options.whyZh: 移動光源後，立體凹痕的陰影可能移動。

explanationZh: 移動光源後，立體凹痕的陰影可能移動。
evidence: Not yet. Shine the lamp along the board. A dent casts a little shadow. Then light it from the opposite end and see whether that shadow moves.

vocabulary.note: 物體或表面形狀阻擋光線而出現暗部。
